ArchiveReviewStatus.description:
Controls the lifecycle of human validation
    over the AI's work.
ArchiveReviewStatus.title: ArchiveReviewStatus

anomaly_reason.description: Reason written to the document when a VALIDATE rule matches.

engine_name.description: Engine used by an LLM_CHECK rule.

preset.description: Preset used by an LLM_CHECK rule.

replacement_string.description: What to replace it with. Leave empty to delete.

rule_kind.description: REWRITE replaces the match; VALIDATE only flags an anomaly; LLM_CHECK asks a model about the title.

changed_by.description: Quem decidiu (autoria, enquanto não há autenticação).

replacement.description: Texto que substitui o trecho quando action=REPLACE.

scope.description: Quem deixa de ler o trecho: EMBEDDING (vetor), NER (extração/classificação) e TITLE (título sugerido).

text.description: Trecho repetido que a IA não deve mais ler.

count.description: How many items are waiting; zero is a valid answer.

description.description: One line explaining what the queue is, for an empty card.

key.description: Stable identifier of the queue, e.g. 'tag_merge_proposals'.

label.description: Text the archivist reads on the card.

route.description: Screen that resolves the queue, already filtered.

allows_children.description: Um nó deste nível pode ter filhos.

description.description: Documentação da gaveta para o curador.

requires_parent.description: Um nó deste nível não pode ser raiz.

access_conditions.description: ISAD(G) 4.1: conditions governing access; the diffusion gate.

anomaly_reasons.description: Codes written by the quality validator.

suggested_final_title.description: Title proposal; never stored, disappears once final_title is written.

access_conditions.description: ISAD(G) 4.1 — condições de acesso. Sem ele o acervo não tem como declarar que uma descrição é restrita, e a difusão não tem como respeitar a restrição.

changed_by.description: Quem revisou (autoria, enquanto não há autenticação).

is_published.description: Decisão de difusão, ortogonal ao status de revisão. Publicar não bloqueia a IA de continuar melhorando o registro; aprovar, sim.

level_id.description: Nível de descrição: id no catálogo (GET /api/v1/hierarchy/levels). A grafia livre saiu do contrato quando a coluna de texto virou chave estrangeira.

review_note.description: Motivo da edição; fica no histórico.

changed_by.description: Quem decidiu; texto livre até haver autenticação.

review_note.description: Por que decidiu; fica no histórico do documento.

counts.description: One entry per issue the diagnostics endpoint accepts, zeroes included.

rooted_early.description: Its parent rung is proposed but not approved, so the node would sit at the root.

remaining_orphans.description: Descriptions that would still have no parent because no rung of their code is approved.

parent_id.description: Descrição superior; omita para criar na raiz.

reference_code.description: Código do novo nó, ex.: 'BR PRADAP SMU'.

new_parent_id.description: Nova unidade superior; null promove à raiz.

is_orphan.description: No parent while its level demands one.

preserved.description: Rungs whose decision was respected and left untouched.

proposed_level_code.description: Catalogue code of the proposed rung.

include_existing.description: Incluir códigos que já têm registro.

flags.description: How many nodes carry each flag.

unparsed_codes.description: Codes the slicer could not read cleanly.

issues.description: Issues ``GET /hierarchy/diagnostics`` accepts, in the order the screen shows them.

plan_flags.description: Every flag a plan row's ``flags`` may carry, from the four vocabularies that write it: the proposal's, the near-duplicate issue, the ladder violation and the slicer's. All of it advisory, none of it a decision.

violations.description: Why a move or a creation is refused, so the screen can explain the refusal.

classifier_label.description: The proposition the NLI model reads. Omitted means the bare name is used.

description.description: Curator-facing documentation. Never sent to the model.

changed_by.description: Who decided; free text until authentication exists.

decided_by.description: Who decided; free text until authentication exists.

changed_by.description: Who merged; free text until authentication exists.

ids_to_merge.description: List of IDs that will be merged and deleted.

limit.description: How many clusters the run may register.

flagged.description: Pending proposals carrying at least one review flag.

pending.description: Proposals still waiting for a human decision.

persisted.description: Rows written or refreshed; a decided proposal is never touched.

reason.description: Why the decision was made; kept for auditing.

words.description: Terms to keep out of the NER extraction.

reversible.description: Always false: the purge has no ledger to restore from.

stopwords.description: The TAG/ALL terms the purge would act on, in lowercase.

total_documents.description: Documents that lose a subject tag.

scope.description: Restringe a remoção a um eixo.

words.description: Words to register before purging; omit to purge with the list already stored.

StopwordsScope.description: Controls the scope of a domain stopword
StopwordsScope.title: StopwordsScope

reason.description: Why the decision was made; kept for auditing.

words.description: Terms to keep out of the subject classifier.

source_type.description: The data source the AI will use to generate the clusters.

min_ratio.description: Fração mínima do acervo para virar candidato.

changed_by.description: Who decided; free text until authentication exists.

macro_category_id.description: Drawer the tag moves into; ``null`` takes it out of the subject axis.

note.description: Why; kept in the tag's ledger.

changed_by.description: Quem decidiu; texto livre até haver autenticação.

review_note.description: Por que decidiu; fica no histórico do documento.

applicable.description: Há tag para absorver: a canônica existe e sobrou ao menos um membro além dela.

canonical_alive.description: Se a tag canônica ainda existe.

members_alive.description: Membros que ainda existem no acervo.
